pieces.file: Rick Rubin — rich — clear away what hides it.m4a
pieces.title: Clear away what hides it
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* Synthesized, including the 'voice', which is a buzz through two formants. Nothing is added after bar one. *Leaking in:* Dub Lineage: subtraction again, but only ever in one direction.

pieces.file: Rick Rubin — rich — clear away what hides it — picture.svg
pieces.title: Clear away what hides it · drawn
pieces.caption: Eight layers at once. One leaves each bar: shaker, arpeggio, pad, second guitar, drums, bass. What is left is a voice and one guitar, which were playing the whole time.

verdicts.file: Rick Rubin — rich — clear away what hides it.m4a
verdicts.why: The title's claim fails by measurement: nothing hides the song. The voice is the loudest thing from bar one, and two of the six removals are too quiet to notice. The order, the bars and "nothing is added" are all true; this is a levels fix.
